userOnboarding.step1: Fill in this form and save. For a Vendor, choose their shop; for a Sales Agent, add their agent code.
userOnboarding.step2: In Supabase → Authentication → Users → Add user, create the login with the same email and a password (tick Auto Confirm).
userOnboarding.step3: The CRM links the login automatically. If the login already existed, it is linked as soon as you save this form.
userOnboarding.noCustomersYet: No customers exist yet. Import or create customers first.
userOnboarding.agentCodeHint: Short code used on customer lists, for example HARIS. Leave blank to use the first name.
userOnboarding.linkedNow: User created and linked. They can log in now.
userOnboarding.alreadyActive: This login is already an active CRM user.
userOnboarding.waitingForLogin: User saved. Now create the login in Supabase Authentication with the same email — it will link automatically.
userOnboarding.pendingHint: These people are saved in the CRM but have no Supabase login yet. After creating the login, press Link now if it does not link automatically.
